The fit is accurate to about 10% over 0.1 <= r/r200m <= 1.5 and out to z = 1.5. The HACC CGD and CTP emulators output scaled profiles, rho_gas/rho_crit(z) and T/T500, on 19 log-spaced bins in r/R500c from 0.0154 to 2.74. Both are trained only for z = 0 to 0.4987, so z=1 is unavailable and the high redshift used is z=0.4987. The halo mass bin and the T500 convention are not reported by the tool.

Finite-difference log slopes in ln-space (grid spacing 0.2878). At z=0: dln rho/dln r = -1.86, -2.54, -2.93 and dln T/dln r = -0.27, -0.58, -0.91 at r/R500 = 0.49, 1.0, 1.54. At z=0.4987: dln rho/dln r = -1.87, -2.74, -3.10 and dln T/dln r = -0.35, -0.51, -1.07. The 1-sigma uncertainty at R500 is about 0.10-0.16 on the density slope and 0.05-0.14 on the temperature slope.

The HSE mass is M_HSE(<x R500)/M500 = -(x t/2)(s_n + s_T), assuming kT500 = G mu m_p M500/(2 R500) and mu=0.59. With this, M_HSE/M500 = 0.41, 0.93+-0.05, 1.27 at z=0 and 0.38, 0.84+-0.05, 1.22 at z=0.4987, at r/R500 = 0.49, 1.0, 1.54. The implied b_HSE,500c is 0.075 at z=0 and 0.16 at z=0.4987. The convention-independent shape-only shift in M_HSE,500c from z=0 to z=0.4987 is -9.2% +- about 8%.

Comparison plots of the emulated profiles at z=0 and z=0.4987 (fiducial parameters) are in Figure 6 (CGD) and Figure 7 (CTP). Scaled density agrees within about 2% over 0.2-0.9 R500 but is about 13% lower at 1.5 R500 at z=0.4987. Scaled temperature is lower at z=0.4987 at all radii above 0.03 R500: by 12% at R500 and by 30% at 2.7 R500.

The formula is M_tot/M500 = (t/2)/(1-f) * [-(s_n+s_T) + dln(1-f)/dln r], with dln(1-f)/dln r = -gamma*u*e^-u/(1+e^-u) and u = (r/R200m/B)^gamma.
